//: Pages Functions run in the Workers runtime, not in Node, so they need a different set
of ambient types from the publish pipeline. They are typechecked in their own pass
rather than by widening the main config: the publish code legitimately uses node:crypto
and node:fs, and a single program claiming to be both runtimes at once would let a Node
API slip into a Worker unnoticed. Both type sets are loaded here because the Functions
import pure modules that the Node pass also compiles.
